newsitem.title: USA: U.S. revises corporate profits data for 1959-1996.
newsitem.headline: U.S. revises corporate profits data for 1959-1996.

text.p: The Commerce Department said on Thursday that it was substantially revising upward its estimates of corporate profits for the years 1959 through 1996.

Under the revisions, profits from current production in 1996 were increased by $16.2 billion, or about 2.5 percent, to $670.2 billion from the previous estimate. The biggest revision came in 1992, where profits were increased by $26.6 billion, or 6.6 percent.
These revisions and others announced by Commerce on Thursday had no impact on the recent performance of gross domestic product or the price index attached to it.
